summary: Fleet create_handoff with base_dir isolates #634 budget hydrate/charge under base_dir/budget and #647 ledger under base_dir/ledger so tests/loops with use_live_budget cannot exhaust repo-root spend.json or spam root ledger (#634/#644/#647).
migration_impact: Local only. Production create_handoff(base_dir=None) still uses repo-root .agentic/budget and .agentic/ledger. Callers that pass base_dir now get fully isolated budget+ledger+checkpoints.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core / pull release with this fix.
2. Unit/integration tests that pass base_dir can safely use_live_budget=True without polluting operator spend.
3. If spend.json was already exhausted by prior test runs, use gh plate autonomy --budget-reset (feature #835).
agent_notes: Pairs with checkpoint base_dir isolation and budget-reset. Prefer base_dir isolation over use_live_budget=False when testing live charge paths.
